scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hear-me-out/shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @hear-me-out/shared" "npm run dev -w @hear-me-out/server" "npm run dev -w @hear-me-out/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hear-me-out/shared && npm run build -w @hear-me-out/server && npm run build -w @hear-me-out/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hear-me-out/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: oxlint --config client/.oxlintrc.json client/src client/vite.config.ts server/src server/test shared/src
scripts.test: npm run build -w @hear-me-out/shared && npm run test -w @hear-me-out/server
